text: Based on the evidence, the property did experience tree cover loss in 2024. The observations indicate a loss of 0.7 hectares of tree cover in 2023 and additional loss in patches under 0.5 hectares in both 2023 and 2024. Specifically, there was a 0.4-hectare loss in 2023 and a 0.7-hectare loss in 2024. Therefore, the property did lose tree cover in 2024.
